summary: Reads one line from a file stream into a caller-supplied buffer under a critical section. If the requested length a2 is non-positive it returns 0 immediately. Otherwise it locks the stream via StreamBufferLockViaCriticalSection, then reads bytes one at a time: it decrements the remaining-buffer counter a3[1] and, when that goes negative, refills via sub_58C255, otherwise consumes *a3++ from the current stream position (field this+0x0). Bytes are copied into the output buffer until a newline (0x0A) or end of input is reached; a 0 terminator is appended. On EOF with no bytes read it returns 0, otherwise it returns the buffer pointer. The critical section is released via AddressRangeCriticalSectionLeave before returning.

operations.description: If the maximum read length a2 is <= 0, return 0 immediately without touching the stream.
Lock the stream object a3 via StreamBufferLockViaCriticalSection before reading.

Read-until-newline loop: guard a2 (stop when it reaches 0); fetch the next byte from the stream, refilling the buffer via sub_58C255 when the remaining counter a3[1] underflows, otherwise consuming the byte at the stream position held in a3[0] (field this+0x0).
Read the next byte from the stream: dereference the current position pointer at a3[0] and advance it (*(*a3)++), or obtain it via the sub_58C255 refill path.
If the byte read equals -1 (end of input): return 0 when nothing has been written yet (v4 == a1), otherwise break out of the loop.
Append the read byte to the output buffer at the write cursor and advance the cursor.
Continue the loop while the last byte written is not a newline (0x0A).
NUL-terminate the output buffer at the write cursor.
Release the stream critical section via AddressRangeCriticalSectionLeave(a3) before returning.
Return the buffer pointer (or 0 when end of input was hit before any byte was read).

Used as a generic config/file line reader by many parsers: ConfigIniParser (0x00421CD0), GearRatioConfigFileReader (0x0042DE10), PitCrewAnimationLoader (0x004A2A90), VehFileParser (0x004C3200), SpecialFX_Init (0x004CF070), ConditionalDispatchBasedOnFlag (0x00566CC0), and sub_402690 / sub_479170.
